blocks.text: Dear Harvest Partner, The month of July brought many events and surely the weather is the strangest yet. Heat waves, floods and droughts seem to be more pronounced than ever before. The weather only indicates the immoral condition of the earth – a sign of God’s judgment swiftly moving across the earth. What once was wrong before the Lord is now right in the eyes of man and what was right before the Lord is wrong. How far have we come? Their interpretation of God’s word has now allowed for them to have a gospel of ease. That’s why it’s so important to stay with this message that Bro. Neal Frisby left and the King James Bible. As I was instructed by Bro. Frisby, those who studied the scrolls with the King James Bible, he said, they would make it in. As one partner spoke to me, he said, I tell them don’t leave the ship, meaning the scroll message. And when Apostle Paul was on the ship he said, every man stay on the ship, don’t leave! And not one soul was lost. They made it to shore. (Acts 27: 30, 31, 44). God will do the same with us as we stay with this prophet’s message. We’re in a transition period of where the prophets to the gentile age have come to an end. Now God will go back to the Jews where the two prophets will appear. They’re looking for a great peace plan. But before this great peace plan will come, as we see now, Israel is already in conflict. They’ve been talking for years, but a conflict will bring peace quicker than talk. The Middle East is a boiling pot. As we know, Israel stands alone in the Middle East amongst all the Islamic nations. This religious difference can only be settled by the anti-Christ (a false peace). For a short period of time there will be peace, then Armageddon. Let us pray for God’s word to reach as many as we can during this period of transition. Already we have sent and are sending many volumes of Brother Frisby’s scrolls, books, over 500 different audio sermons and many DVD’s overseas. Wonderful reports have come back about the excitement and the joy over his ministry with such gratitude and thankfulness for the true word of God that Brother Frisby delivered to the saints! – And now a special quote from Neal Frisby: “I believe the Lord brought us together in divine purpose to help in the gospel as we bring the real word of God to His elect. It was predestinated for you to know of this work! – As I prayed the Holy Spirit led me to these Scriptures that will most help my partners in the months ahead to encourage and increase your faith. – As you act – Thy way shall be opened up step by step before thee! (Prov. 4:12) It means day by day He will lead you into all His blessings! – Thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and thou shalt have good success! (Josh. 1:8) For the Lord thy God doth go with thee, He will not fail thee nor forsake thee! (Deut. 31:6) – He that hath begun a good work in you will perform it! (Phil. 1:6) He will bless you in all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ! (Eph. 1:3)”

“He that asketh definitely receiveth. Believe it! (Matt. 7:8) – Whatsoever ye ask in My name I will do! Ask anything in My name and I will do it! (John 14: 13-14) – All things ye ask, believing, ye shall receive! (Matt. 21:22) – If two agree it shall be done! (Matt. 18:19) – As we abide in Christ together it shall be done! (John 15:7) – Nothing shall be impossible! (Matt. 17:20) – As we act together ALL things shall be possible in the days ahead! (Mark 9:23)” “Jesus gives us all power over the enemy! (Luke 10:18-19) – Great is our Lord, and of great power: His understanding is infinite! (Ps. 147:5) – I will bless thee! (Gen. 12:2) – I will not fail thee! (Josh. 1:5) – I will heal thee! (II Kings 20:5) – I will guide thee! (Isa. 41:10) – I will not forget thee! (Isa. 49:15) – I will forgive! (Jer. 31:34) – Those who hearken shall dwell safely and shall be quiet from fear of evil! (Prov. 1:33) – I will give thee a crown of life! (Rev. 2:10) – I want to leave you with one final Scripture. “Take no thought, for He will take care of you and bless; For you are more important than the lilies. (Matt. 6:27-34)” END QUOTE.

This month we have a valuable book that will help you restore your salvation and joy during these troublesome times. – A must read called “Salvation, Joy and Protection!” For all those who help this month we will send you this valuable book. We have many projects underway. We will speak more on this later. May the Lord richly bless and keep you.
